topic: learn numbers 1 to 12 with movement for kids
learningGoal: recognize numerals 1-12 and connect each numeral to its English number word
characterReference: selected KM-007 Szene 01 cover reference ONLY
introVoiceText: Welcome to KidMotion Count and Move! Today we’ll learn numbers one to twelve with fun freeze poses. Look for each number and say it with me. Clear some space, move safely, and stop if anything hurts. Ready to count? Let’s begin!

openingVoiceSections.label: INTRO

openingVoiceSections.label: SAFETY
